{"draft": "Rockwell Automation — Strong Organic Growth Lifts Earnings
A double-digit organic sales advance, expanding profitability and solid cash generation marked a strong third quarter.
Revenue climbed to $2,313 million, up 8% year over year, as organic sales grew 10%. Profitability improved alongside that growth, with Net income attributable to Rockwell Automation reaching $408 million, or $3.65 per share. Adjusted EPS came in at $3.49, up 22% year over year, while Enterprise operating margin expanded to 22.3%.
Segment performance was led by Intelligent Devices, where sales rose to $1.1 billion, an increase of 12%. Software & Control delivered the fastest growth, with sales of $751 million, up 19%, and segment operating margin reaching 34.8%. Lifecycle Services was softer, with sales slipping to $482 million, a decrease of (12)% year over year.
Cash generation strengthened during the quarter, with cash provided by operating activities of $724 million and free cash flow of $654 million. Capital returns continued through share repurchases costing $145 million in the quarter.
Outlook: For fiscal 2026, the company updated its reported sales growth and organic sales growth ranges to 7.5% - 9.5%. It also updated diluted EPS guidance to $12.72 - $13.02 and Adjusted EPS guidance to $13.00 - $13.30."}
